_comment: Attach-Turbo settings. packageZip: "auto" = newest packagePattern zip under packageSearchRoot that has a .sha256 beside it (<zip>.sha256 or <name>.sha256), or an absolute zip path (then a .sha256 beside it or packageSha256 is required). expectedDllMd5: empty = taken from the verified package. Paths must be absolute; %USERPROFILE% style variables are expanded. A Live Editor inside gameFolder is reported, never written.
